ui.tasks.duplicate_ids.title: Duplicate task IDs
ui.tasks.duplicate_ids.warning: Warning: Tasks were found with the same ID and space.
ui.tasks.duplicate_ids.ask_guidance: Would you like correction guidance? Yes: open instructions. No: continue without changing data.
ui.tasks.duplicate_ids.guidance:
Duplicate tasks are highlighted in red and bold in the tree.

How to resolve this safely:
1. Make a backup copy of tasks.data.
2. Search for the reported ID and compare the duplicate tasks to identify the intended records.
3. If both tasks must exist, choose an unused ID for one of them.
4. Also update references that should point to the renumbered task, such as NPC links, prerequisites, and subtasks.
5. Save and reopen the file to verify it.

The editor does not change IDs automatically because it cannot determine which task each reference was meant to use. Choosing No continues loading without modifying any data.
